description: Elections Commission - R. D. Indunil of the Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette notice is a declaration by a Returning Officer under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance regarding the vacation of office by a member of a Pradeshiya Sabha (local authority) due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, fitting the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for matters concerning electoral processes and related administrative actions.
